measurement_defects.finding: The visible candidate contract specifies a generic value field and arbitrary reason-code strings, but the grader requires the hidden oracle's exact per-case value shape and exact reason-code set.
measurement_defects.impact: A semantically aligned scalar or explanatory reason list deterministically fails exact oracle matching; qwen3.8-max had zero exact reason-code matches despite 11/12 exact status matches.

measurement_defects.finding: The grader reuses oracle_match for evidence support and calculation correctness, and status_match for method applicability.
measurement_defects.impact: The reported invariant failures and 0/36 end-to-end result are correlated derivatives, not independent measurements of evidence, calculation, and method quality.

measurement_defects.finding: Evidence validity requires every registered record ID although selected cases declare minimum_evidence_count=1.
measurement_defects.impact: Target-year answers can be marked unsupported even when the model read all records and cited the material target record.

measurement_defects.finding: The permission invariant requires a parsed self-declaration and therefore fails on invalid output, while the same label also implies execution safety.
measurement_defects.impact: Twenty-three permission-invariant failures cannot be interpreted as unauthorized actions; tool traces show zero buy/sell calls and zero real side effects.

measurement_defects.finding: Invalid final candidate text is discarded and only its hash is retained.
measurement_defects.impact: The exact parse failure class for all 12 GLM and 11 DeepSeek outputs is not recoverable offline.

measurement_defects.finding: An invalid structured output is written to trace.result.action as abstain by default.
measurement_defects.impact: Trace action counts would conflate parse failure with deliberate abstention; grader.actual_status=null is the authoritative field.

measurement_defects.finding: The calculate tool schema accepts an unconstrained inputs object, but runtime requires inputs.values as an array of decimal strings.
measurement_defects.impact: GLM used schema-valid inputs.value and received a runtime tool error; the schema does not expose the actual callable contract.

measurement_defects.finding: Visible task inputs include fields such as force_abstain_reason.
measurement_defects.impact: Some diagnostic reason codes are leaked despite the prompt describing the oracle as removed.

interpretation.direct_evidence: The provider/tool loop is compatible and execution boundaries held; the frozen exact-output contract was not satisfied.
interpretation.inference: The primary next bottleneck is benchmark measurement design plus model output-format adherence, not Bailian schema/tool-choice compatibility.
not_supported: The L2/L3 labels are observed financial losses
GLM and DeepSeek parse failures have a known exact syntax cause

decision.next_step: Publish a new preregistered candidate-output schema, reason-code vocabulary, independent invariant graders, aligned tool schemas, and redacted parse diagnostics; validate them on synthetic fixtures before any paid rerun.
